model_accuracy: Every base-ten model verified against its printed number. Page 4: 34 = 3 rods + 4 ones; 43 = 4 rods + 3 ones; 52 = 5 rods + 2 ones; 57 = 5 rods + 7 ones; 60 = 6 rods on both sides; 81 = 8 rods + 1 one; 18 = 1 rod + 8 ones. Each rod is exactly 10 joined cubes.

pages_detail.activities: Count turquoise ten-rods and gold ones cubes; write tens, ones, and the number
pages_detail.title: Count the Rods and Ones

pages_detail.activities: Given a numeral, write its tens and ones and draw the rods and ones in separate sections
pages_detail.title: Draw the Model

pages_detail.activities: Compare two two-digit numbers using base-ten models; one symbol box per pair
pages_detail.title: Compare with >, <, =

pages_detail.activities: Independent practice, no pictures: circle the greatest, write >, <, =, order least to greatest
pages_detail.title: Compare and Order
